description: List articles from DEV.to. Uses the Forem API first and falls back to browser extraction when the API fails.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: popular (default), latest, or top. Only latest and top are supported for the site-wide feed via API.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Time period for top sorting: week, month, year, or infinity. API only.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter by a single tag, e.g. {tag}.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Filter by an organization username, e.g. {org}.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return, default 30, max 1000.
